audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer repeatedly cites a fabricated ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability named that — his real kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. The described effect ('All his CC lives on E') matches Subject: Torment (E).
audit.why: Packet defect flags that the full layer never names any of Hwei's real abilities. Every mention of the fake name is corrected to Subject: Torment (E), the actual CC ability, with its real 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown folded in.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, and report[9].t; added the real cooldown number.

audit.why: Full phases[N].side and content win[N] already agree row-for-row (Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Seraphine) — no chart edit needed.
Spikes correctly track the even level-2 poke, the level-6 QQE execute threat, first-item Malignance/Liandry poke, and the late-game AoE-charm flip that matches the 53.35% winrate.
